## Architecture Overview

The `Type` field in `corev1.ServiceSpec` is value type `ServiceType`. Changing to pointer `*ServiceType` breaks all code that compares `svc.Spec.Type == corev1.ServiceTypeLoadBalancer` etc., since pointer comparison semantics differ.

## Detailed Analysis

### Helm

- **`pkg/kube/ready.go`** (lines 249-274) — `s.Spec.Type == corev1.ServiceTypeExternalName` (line 249), `s.Spec.Type == corev1.ServiceTypeLoadBalancer` (line 260). Readiness checking logic.

### ArgoCD

- **`gitops-engine/pkg/health/health_service.go`** (line 30) — `service.Spec.Type == corev1.ServiceTypeLoadBalancer` for health status determination.

### Ingress-Nginx

- **`internal/ingress/status/status.go`** (line 361) — Switch on `svc.Spec.Type` against all four service types (ExternalName, ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer).
- **`internal/ingress/controller/controller.go`** (line 1208) — `svc.Spec.Type == apiv1.ServiceTypeExternalName`.
- **`internal/ingress/controller/store/store.go`** (lines 810, 832) — `svc.Spec.Type == corev1.ServiceTypeExternalName`.

### External-DNS

- **`source/service.go`** (lines 582, 602) — Switch on `svc.Spec.Type` against all four variants.
- **`source/compatibility.go`** (line 112) — Switch on `svc.Spec.Type` for legacy annotations.
- **`source/gloo_proxy.go`** (line 311) — `svc.Spec.Type` comparison with LoadBalancer.

### Prometheus

- **`discovery/kubernetes/service.go`** (lines 227-238) — `string(svc.Spec.Type)` conversion, `svc.Spec.Type == apiv1.ServiceTypeExternalName`, `svc.Spec.Type == apiv1.ServiceTypeLoadBalancer`.

| helm | pkg/kube/ready.go | ServiceType equality comparisons for readiness |
| argo-cd | gitops-engine/pkg/health/health_service.go | ServiceTypeLoadBalancer comparison for health |

| ingress-nginx | internal/ingress/controller/controller.go | ServiceTypeExternalName comparison |
| ingress-nginx | internal/ingress/controller/store/store.go | ServiceTypeExternalName filtering |
| external-dns | source/service.go | Switch on all four ServiceType variants |
| external-dns | source/compatibility.go | Legacy ServiceType switch |
